Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner inverted the age comparison logic. After correctly finding the birth years (Fred Williamson: 1938; Andrei Svislotskiy: 1960), it stated that because 1960 > 1938, Andrei Svislotskiy is older, which is false. An earlier birth year indicates an older person, so the correct conclusion should have been that Fred Williamson is older and thus One Down, Two To Go is the film with the older director.
